summary.text: Diane Kelley is a Republican state representative from Hillsborough 32 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; she assumed her current seat in December 2022.
She is a real estate agent.

paragraphs.text: Diane Kelley earned a B.S. from California State University, Channel Islands, in 2009.
Her career experience includes working as a real estate agent.
Ballotpedia lists Kelley's tenure in the New Hampshire House as beginning in 2020, and she assumed her current seat representing Hillsborough 32 on December 7, 2022.
She was assigned to the House Judiciary Committee in 2021-2022 and to the Municipal and County Government Committee in 2023-2024.
She advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026.
